title: Asima Ahmad (Carrot co-founder) featured at Trump administration women's health summit
summary: Carrot co-founder Dr. Asima Ahmad presented at HHS National Conference on Women's Health. Carrot gaining visibility at federal level.

title: Maven Clinic expands award-winning Fertility & Family Building solution with focus on natural conception
summary: Maven expands fertility and family building solution with new focus on natural conception support. MAXIS GBN partnership mentioned for global expansion.

title: Carrot Fertility COO Brooke Quinn on leading a fertility benefits company
summary: Profile of Carrot COO Brooke Quinn. Company has raised tens of millions selling benefits to employers and large health plans. Insight into leadership and company direction.

title: Carrot Presents AI-Powered Metabolic-Fertility Research at National Conference on Women's Health Hosted by HHS
summary: Carrot introduced 'Sprints' — first program combining generative AI with continuous wearable biometrics to optimize metabolic health before pregnancy. Proposes 'Premester' clinical framework for preconception care. Presented at Trump administration women's health summit.

title: Future Family Partners with Kindbody to Expand Access to Fertility Care Through Innovative Financing Solutions
summary: Future Family (fertility financing platform) partnered with Kindbody to offer personalized financing for IVF, IUI, egg freezing, medications, genetic testing, and donor services across Kindbody's national clinic network.

title: Maven Clinic Introduces Maven Intelligence, an AI-Powered Orchestration Layer for Women's and Family Health
summary: Maven Clinic launched Maven Intelligence, an AI-powered orchestration layer embedded across its virtual clinic, care programs, and benefits platform. Built on OpenAI and Google LLMs with business associate agreements. Expands AI capabilities with genAI agent.

title: Luna and Kindbody partner to bring data-driven insight to women's health and fertility care
summary: Luna (healthtech) and Kindbody announced strategic partnership for personalized data in reproductive health. Kindbody launched AI-integrated fertility platform in February 2026, entering pilot with employer clients covering 3M+ lives.
